23. We shall now examine the evidence of the prosecutrix. 
The prosecutrix at the relevant time was less than 18 years of

in concluding that there was no reasonable and plausible

consultation and due deliberation and that creates doubt about

28. We are not oblivious of the fact that the incident is of 
1989; the prosecutrix has married after the incident and A-1 
has a family of his own and sending A-1 to jail now may disturb

persuades us for a soft option. Rape is a heinous crime and 
once it is established against a person charged of the offence, 
justice must be done to the victim of crime by awarding suitable

punishment to the crime doer. We are constrained to observe

F that criminal justice system is not working in our country as it

should. The police reforms have not taken place despite 
directions of this Court in the case of Prakash Singh & Ors. 
vs. Union of India & Ors. 9• We do not intend to say anything 
more in this regard since matter is being dealt with separately

orientation; they do not have modern tools. On many occasions

The criminal trials are protracted because of non-appearance 
of official witnesses on time and the non-availability of the

facilities for recording evidence by video conferencing. The

public prosecutors have their limitations; the defence lawyers
